runtimeMapping.ordinaryAttack: GROUND one retained victim; original random Attack_A/B or Skill_1_A/B events at .433; playback min(1,base BAT/current interval)
runtimeMapping.deployment: S1/S2 cast-on-locate represented by protected one-second original born then full ten/eight-second window. S3 casts on creation, immediately invisible/block zero/smoke, loses born protection and starts execution after one-second original Start_3.
runtimeMapping.smoke: Mode-owned GROUND hit-rate aura uses x-4 for S1/S2, skill x-1 for S3; native talent scale only in S2; removed on leaving/detach
runtimeMapping.s2: Eight-second start expires into mode 4; original .6-second Skill_2_End CAST resamples all ground cloud targets. Control/withdrawal cancels pre-hit job; original 1.3-second tail blocks ordinary attacks.
runtimeMapping.s3: FIXED s3_cd two-second cooldown, one retained unmarked ground victim in skill smoke grid, original table hit_interval .1 delivers second hit and each applies source stun. No invented core attack clip: source animation remains Skill_3_Loop.
runtimeMapping.mark: ON_OUTPUT_MODIFIER creates independent owner six-second mark before damage evasion, no max-stack refresh; parent finish clears it. Any outgoing modifier while S3 active qualifies.
runtimeMapping.glory: Selected E2/P5 final Physical damage scale against ground victims unless that entity has delivered positive non-cancelled damage to Crownslayer this deployment; source parent teardown resets ownership.

verificationLimits: Native C# callback bodies and frame dispatch remain unrecovered; deployment locate boundary, first S3 cast, state handoff and cooldown scheduling are local mappings of the serialized graph, not native-frame certification.

Native multi-hit additionalTimes/triggerDelta are literal 1/0; the adapter resolves second-hit spacing from selected attack@hit_interval .1. Compiled blackboard binding and same-event status/damage order are not certified.
S3 smoke selection uses the skill x-1 selector; core UI sight remains base 1-1. Native visibility/sight occlusion and forced movement interaction remain unverified.
Talent damage-history tracking uses positive final damage receipts; native cancelled-modifier versus zero or shielded damage callback boundaries are not recovered.
Independent mark sources are keyed by runtime entity; regular squads reject duplicate operators. Native cross-producer durable mark behavior remains unverified.
Modules and original Unity smoke/strike particles/audio are not implemented; literal actor clips are delivered, but effect parity is unfinished.
Synthetic status/flyer tests do not enable additional enemy kits or stages. Physical-device touch is not certified.

authoredGameplayNotes.scope: Authored notes corroborate S2 taunt -1, S3 immediate block zero/lost born protection, general output marks and reveal removal of invisible/block buff. Game bundles remain the primary evidence.
